stalls.summaryZh: 芋泥綿密，包鹹蛋黃和肉鬆，鹹甜層次豐富，香酥芋丸也很熱門；常常還沒開攤就大排長龍。也有網友覺得普通、不值得久等。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Smooth taro paste around salted egg yolk and pork floss, a rich sweet-savoury mix. The crispy taro balls are popular too. The line often forms before the stall opens, though some reviewers find it ordinary and not worth the wait. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.en: Zhu Gan Rong Zai Pork Liver Soup
stalls.summaryZh: 豬肝厚度剛好、口感脆嫩沒有腥味，湯頭清甜可免費加湯，搭肉粽吃剛好；開店前就有人排隊。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Pork liver cut just thick enough, tender with a slight crunch and no gamey taste, in a clear, sweet broth with free refills. Pairs well with a rice dumpling. People queue before it opens. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.where: 寧夏路 46 號（寧夏路與民生西路口）
stalls.summaryZh: 鮮蚵從台南直送，粉漿偏厚偏軟，跟焦脆派不同；整排蚵仔煎在鐵板上煎的畫面很吸睛。米其林指南曾推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Oysters come straight from Tainan. The batter is thick and soft rather than crisp. Watching rows of omelets on the griddle is part of the fun. It has been recommended in the Michelin Guide.

stalls.summaryZh: 雞肉絲淋上長時間熬的滷汁，香氣足，配燙青菜和湯成一套很常見；週一公休。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Shredded chicken over rice with a long-simmered sauce, very fragrant. Most people make it a set with blanched greens and soup. Closed Mondays. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.summaryZh: 近 80 年老店，湯頭濃但不燥、帶微微酒香，一碗雞腿肉給得多，夏天也一樣有人潮；週一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: A shop of nearly 80 years. The broth is rich but not harsh, with a light rice-wine aroma, and each bowl has plenty of chicken leg. Busy even in summer. Closed Mondays.

stalls.summaryZh: 沙茶牛肉現炒鍋氣足、很下飯，控肉飯軟嫩入味也很多人專程來點，是開業數十年的老攤。
stalls.summaryEn: Satay beef stir-fried to order with strong wok aroma, great with rice. Many people come just for the tender braised pork belly rice. A stall running for decades.

stalls.where: 寧夏路 49 號（夜市旁店面）
stalls.summaryZh: 近 60 年老店，用甘蔗冰沙代替糖水，清爽解膩；黑心白玉芝麻餡濃、口感Q，從白天到深夜都排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: A shop of nearly 60 years that uses sugarcane slush instead of syrup, so it feels light and refreshing. The black sesame mochi balls are rich and chewy. Lines from daytime until late night.

stalls.summaryZh: 蔥油餅包鐵板炒麵或肉類，料多到爆，外酥內滿，網友說一份可以當兩餐或分著吃；週一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: A scallion pancake wrapped around teppan noodles or meat, packed with filling, crisp outside and full inside. Reviewers say one is enough for two meals or for sharing. Closed Mondays.

stalls.summaryZh: 腿庫用黑毛豬，皮厚肉嫩、肥瘦分明，滷得香Q不膩，配筍絲和滷蛋很飽足。
stalls.summaryEn: Pork knuckle from black-haired pigs, with thick skin, tender meat and a clear fat-to-lean balance. Braised until chewy but not greasy, served with bamboo shoots and egg. Very filling.

stalls.summaryZh: 熱麻糬配煉乳刨冰，裹花生芝麻粉，冷熱對比是特色，麻糬Q軟不黏；外國旅客也常排隊。週日、一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Warm mochi on condensed-milk shaved ice, coated in peanut and sesame powder. The hot-and-cold contrast is the draw, and the mochi is soft but not sticky. Popular with foreign visitors. Closed Sundays and Mondays.
